`abstract class BitmapTextRenderer<F extends IFontFace>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`GlyphTextRenderer<F>`](/reference/text/glyphtextrenderer/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.bitmap` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BitmapTextRenderer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/bitmap/BitmapTextRenderer.java)

Base class of the text renderers of pixel fonts, which draws each glyph from the `BitmapCell` you return.

## Description

Extend it for your [`BitmapFont`](/reference/text/bitmapfont/) and implement `getCell`; layout, markups, effects, shadows and colors come from [`GlyphTextRenderer`](/reference/text/glyphtextrenderer/).
The origin, the baseline and the offsets of the glyphs snap to whole screen pixels, and the texture of each cell is sampled with `NEAREST` filtering and filtered by area in the shader.

## Method details

<a id="BitmapTextRenderer-method-drawGlyph"></a>

### drawGlyph

`void drawGlyph(TextGlyph<F> glyph)` <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Draws the cell of the glyph, scaled from its bitmap size to the size of the glyph, slanted when the style is italic and the face is not.
A glyph whose cell is `null` draws nothing.

<a id="BitmapTextRenderer-method-begin"></a>

### begin

`void begin()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Binds the shader and starts the pass with no texture bound.

<a id="BitmapTextRenderer-method-isGridAligned"></a>

### isGridAligned

`boolean isGridAligned()` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

Always `true`: bitmap glyphs sit on whole screen pixels.

<a id="BitmapTextRenderer-method-getCell"></a>

### getCell

`BitmapCell getCell(TextGlyph<F> glyph)` <span class="joid-qualifier">hook</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">protected</span>

JOID calls it for every glyph it draws, on the render thread.
Return the [`BitmapCell`](/reference/text/bitmapcell/) of the glyph's codepoint in its face, or `null` to skip it.
